parameters.query:
-- pull candidate accounts with everything the rule engine needs: health_score (6.1.1), tenure, adoption status (6.2.1)
SELECT
  id AS client_id, odoo_lead_id, name, email, service_type, status,
  health_score, health_score_snapshot_at,
  created_at, adoption_checklist_created_at,
  EXTRACT(DAY FROM (now() - created_at)) AS tenure_days
FROM clients_master
WHERE status IN ('Onboarded', 'Active/Onboarded (recurring)')
  AND health_score IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 100;

nodes.name: Get Candidate Accounts
nodes.notes: Restricted to accounts that already have a health_score (i.e. 6.1.1 has run at least once) - upsell logic depends on that data existing.

nodes.name: Ollama Suggestion Generation
nodes.notes: 6.4.1.2. Explicitly instructed not to generate pricing (this plan's top blocker, §10A.5/§16.1, is Ollama-hallucinated pricing already live in Module 2.4 - do not repeat that pattern here). Output is a conversation starter for a human rep, not a quote or commitment.

nodes.name: Odoo Activity-Create
nodes.notes: 6.4.1.3. Uses mail.activity.create on the existing crm.lead record (Odoo's standard 'to-do' pattern), reusing ODOO_SALES_USER_ID which is already in §10A.2's env var list. ODOO_UPSELL_ACTIVITY_TYPE_ID is a NEW env var (parallel to the existing ODOO_LINKEDIN_ACTIVITY_TYPE_ID / ODOO_RENEWAL_ACTIVITY_TYPE_ID pattern) - needs to be created in Odoo and added to the variable list.
